info.title: Passport API
info.description:
The Passport API: create and read income verifications, receive decisions by webhook, download evidence, and send families from a booking checkout to a partner SGO.

Authenticate with a secret key: `Authorization: Bearer ecca_test_…` (test mode) or `ecca_live_…` (live mode). A key only ever sees its own organization's data in its own mode.
Rate limit: 600 requests per minute per key (RateLimit-* headers). POST requests accept an Idempotency-Key, remembered for 24 hours.
Webhooks are signed per Standard Webhooks (webhook-id, webhook-timestamp, webhook-signature) and retried up to 7 attempts. Event types: verification.started, verification.submitted, verification.needs_review, verification.decided, verification.expired, verification.canceled, donation.succeeded, donation.refunded, acknowledgment.issued, award.offered, handoff.started, handoff.held, handoff.eligible, handoff.awarded, handoff.declined, handoff.expired, handoff.completed.

Not legal or tax advice. Section 25F eligibility rules are proposed regulations, not final; income limits are provisional until the IRS publishes its table.

post.description: Starts an income verification and returns the family link (family_url) and an embeddable link (embed_url). Both are returned only here.
